A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MTI research work. Their text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching retained content across reflow and appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark accuracy, inference latency, CFG usage, ablations and qualitative analyses, including the appendix experiments in Tables 5–8.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results and adds a Math500 failure example comparing two entropy thresholds in Appendix A.9.

M1.justification: Both versions use entropy-gated CFG and negative-prompt injection through conditional KV-cache reuse. The token/logit notation clarifications and additional examples do not introduce a new component or change the inference procedure.

E1.justification: The evaluated language, coding, STEM and spatial-vision coverage is retained. Appendix A.9 reuses Math500; the dragon example in A.8 illustrates standard CFG rather than documenting an additional MTI evaluation task.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain DI, vanilla CFG, TALE, NoThinking, Dynasor, DEER, CGRS and the contrastive-decoding comparisons. Newly cited decoding papers are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Appendix A.9 adds a single-example comparison of entropy thresholds 2.0 and 2.5, extending beyond the retained Table 1 sweep ending at 2.0. Existing benchmark metrics, context length and greedy/random-sampling settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The existing ablations, entropy-scope analysis and DI-versus-CFG case study remain. New Appendix A.9 and Figure 8 examine how an excessively high threshold misses interventions needed to avoid an arithmetic error.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages over eight AIME2024 sampling runs in Section 4.1, Table 2 and Appendix A.1. No seed values, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical testing procedures are added.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1–8 are unchanged; Section 4.2 highlights different results already present in Table 2. Figure 8 adds a Math500 example yielding an incorrect answer of 41 at threshold 2.5 and the correct answer of 14 at threshold 2.0.

T1.justification: The CFG/CD algebra, entropy definitions and cache expressions retain their mathematical substance. Replacing logits l_t with tokens x_t in probability arguments clarifies notation; no substantive assumption, derivation, theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The main claims about localized reasoning uncertainty, training-free selective guidance and efficient reasoning improvements remain, including the abstract's headline gains. Although removed from the conclusion, compatibility and orthogonality claims remain elsewhere, notably Appendix A.7.

C2.justification: Section 6 newly acknowledges that the benefits of meaningless and positive prompts remain insufficiently understood. Threshold-tuning discussion remains in Section 4.3 and gains a concrete failure interpretation in A.9. Section 4.4 also connects shorter outputs to token reduction.

D1.justification: v4 identifies DeepSeek-R1-7B as the source of Figure 3a and clarifies that the unchanged word clouds concern high-entropy tokens. It documents non-thinking mode and the prompt for the new failure example. The code link and OpenCompass configuration-file disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v4 adds Chuang et al. (2023) on DoLa, Kong et al. (2025) on token reduction and Xu et al. (2026) on entropy-aware decoding. Most other bibliography changes update metadata or consolidate duplicate references, without substantially changing research positioning.

P1.justification: There are localized rewrites of notation, ablation explanations and limitations, plus removal of duplicated wording and an author-line edit. Two explanatory appendix subsections are added, moving the existing LLM-use disclosure from A.8 to A.10; the overall narrative structure remains.

P2.justification: Figure 3c changes from a line chart to a bar chart with the same findings. Several tables are enlarged or reformatted, Figure 2's caption is shortened, and Figures 7–8 add explanatory examples. The remaining displays are retained through page reflow.

improvement.justification: v4 provides clearer notation and displays, explicitly acknowledges an unresolved explanation for prompt effects, and illustrates a concrete threshold-related failure. These improve clarity and scientific qualification while retaining the existing evidence. The gains are limited refinements rather than a substantial strengthening of the empirical foundation.
